ip_digestive_complete.name: Digestive Complete
ip_digestive_complete.key: Per 2 capsules: 600 mg betaine HCl, 80 mg pepsin, 350 mg ox bile and pancreatic enzymes
sched: capsules across two meals to day 10: 2 with breakfast, 2 with lunch
ip_digestive_complete.src: Amounts and directions: products DB R987 (scratchpad products/nutridyn_products.json; NutriDyn catalog ND143 10/1/26 as read by the Designs for Health, Thorne, Standard Process and Apex switch charts): per 2 capsules betaine HCl 600 mg, pepsin 80 mg, ox bile 350 mg, pancreatic enzymes protease 35,000 USP, amylase 35,000 USP, lipase 7,000 USP (the serving line names the enzymes without their units, for space); directions 'Take two capsules with each meal or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' Sizes R987 60C, R987L 180C (NutriDyn price list ND144 10/1/26, via the DB). Web search 2026-11-03: NutriDyn sell sheet ND566 (Rev. 3/21) lists the same pepsin (1:10,000) 80 mg, betaine HCl 600 mg and ox bile 350 mg, a porcine (pork) enzyme blend, and L-taurine, gentian, dandelion and fennel (sheet not opened: nutridyn.com is blocked from this session); the pork source is why the check panel asks about a beef or pork allergy. Protocol: NutriDyn 5R GI Restoration Program ND584 Rev. 1/22, REPLACE step, 'This stage occurs during days 1-10 ... Digestive Complete: 3 capsules per meal for 10 days'; the sheet prints the label dose (2 with each meal, because 3 per meal is above the label) for the protocol's days 1 to 10. Daily rhythm: 2 with breakfast and 2 with lunch are listed together under Morning as '4 capsules across two meals' (the kit has no midday slot), 2 with the evening meal. NutriDyn GLC 2023 5R protocol list (CSO) names it under Enzyme/HCL; NutriDyn CSO pearls video chapters (repo onboard pearls page): 'Digestive Complete: dual-phase acid and enzyme support with ox bile'. Not for an ulcer or gastritis: Asher's ulcer and HCl email, 2019-09-05 ('We do not use the conventional way to increase HCL in patients with ulcers'). URL: the /digestive-complete slug is the one NutriDyn's practitioner storefronts index for this product (web search 2026-11-03; their product slugs mirror the main site's), the main-site page could not be opened. PHOTO: only the 90x160 px chart thumbnail is in reach (scratchpad products/img/R987.png); the print master is R987_Web or R987L_Web in Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/ (the Dropbox content host is blocked from this session). Stage it as build/img-src/R987.png.

ip_gi_integrity.name: GI Integrity
ip_gi_integrity.key: 3 g L‑glutamine, 1 g glucosamine HCl, 400 mg DGL licorice, 300 mg aloe, 200 mg slippery elm, 16.1 mg zinc (as zinc carnosine)
ip_gi_integrity.src: Amounts: NutriDyn practice kit GI Integrity handout (repo handouts/nutridyn-practice-kit.pdf, 'IN ONE SCOOP (8.5 G)': L-Glutamine 3 g, Zinc (as zinc-carnosine) 16.1 mg, DGL licorice root 400 mg, Aloe vera leaf gel 300 mg, Slippery elm bark 200 mg, 'Plus glucosamine HCl 1 g, apple pectin 1 g, marshmallow, chamomile, okra, cat's claw, MSM, quercetin and prune. No added sugars.'; 'Do not use if pregnant or nursing.'); products DB R327 agrees (catalog ND143 p.100 prints the Peach Tea panel, R325: 8.5 g scoop, 28 servings; quercetin 100 mg per the Metagenics chart); a web search of NutriDyn's GI Integrity listings (2026-11-03) shows L-glutamine 3 g, glucosamine HCl 1 g and zinc 16.1 mg (as zinc-carnosine, 62 mg L-carnosine). Glucosamine is on the serving line so a patient on warfarin, or with a shellfish allergy, can spot it (the label does not say what the glucosamine is made from). 'DGL' = deglycyrrhizinated licorice. Size line: flavors only. 28 servings is confirmed only for the 238 g Peach Tea panel (R325); the Berry (R327, 238 g) and Chocolate (R328, 362.9 g) panels are not printed, so no count is printed. Label direction 'Mix one scoop with 6-8 ounces of water or as directed by your healthcare practitioner' states no frequency, so the protocol dose applies: ND584 Rev. 1/22 REPAIR step 'Dynamic GI Integrity: 1 scoop twice daily for 10 days (1 canister)' and Asher's GI-MAP protocol email, 2025-01-30 (Calprotectin/Zonulin section): 'Mix one scoop (7g) with 6-8 ounces of water twice daily.' The practice kit: 'GI Integrity is the anchor.' URL: web search 2026-11-03 indexes the /dyn-gi-integrity slug (page not opened, nutridyn.com blocked). Photo: build/img-src/R325.png, 1024x1428 text-safe upscale of the 420 px Peach Tea render.

ip_gi_defend.name: GI Defend
ip_gi_defend.key: 2.5 g ImmunoLin (serum‑derived bovine immunoglobulin isolate), from beef serum, not milk
ip_gi_defend.dosesub: days 1 to 10, in the GI Integrity shake
sched: scoop, in the GI Integrity shake
scoop, in the GI Integrity shake
ip_gi_defend.src: Amount: products DB R191 (Microbiome Labs switch chart, catalog ND143 10/1/26): 'ImmunoLin per serving: NutriDyn 2.5 g (1 scoop, IgG content not stated on label)'; directions 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water or your favorite beverage as a dietary supplement or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.' Size R191 75 g (NutriDyn price list ND144, via the DB); a web search 2026-11-03 of NutriDyn's GI Defend listing shows the same 2.5 g bovine immunoglobulin protein isolate (ImmunoLin), a 75 g (2.6 oz) container and 'NO: GMOs, gluten, dairy'. 'From beef serum, not milk; no lactose': the NutriDyn Nutritional Support Knowledge Base text, quoted in Asher's email of 2022-05-04: serum-derived bovine immunoglobulin, 'no lactose', and 'Colostrum dairy proteins are sensitizing for many' (scratchpad protocols/raw/notes_gmail.md). Being beef-derived is why the check panel asks about a beef or pork allergy. Claims: the same text, 'binds these toxins together, making them too large to pass through the gut barrier' and 'promotes healthy immune activation responses in supporting low gut permeability'. Dose: the label states no frequency, so the protocol applies: ND584 Rev. 1/22 REPAIR 'Dynamic GI Defend: 1 scoop twice daily for 10 days'; Asher's GI-MAP protocol email, 2025-01-30: 'Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water ... or mix with Dynamic GI Integrity, twice daily.', hence 'in the GI Integrity shake'. URL slug: products.py SLUGS (NutriDyn 60-day protocol doc) and a web search on 2026-11-03 (the /dynamic-gi-defend-r191 page is indexed on nutridyn.com). PHOTO: build/img-src/R191.png is a 584x640 Lanczos stopgap of a 146x160 thumbnail (SOFT); the print master is R191_Web in Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/ (Dropbox content host blocked from this session).

ip_ultrabiotic_dms.name: UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain
ip_ultrabiotic_dms.key: 30 billion CFU at manufacture, 7 strains, including S. boulardii (5 billion), L. acidophilus and B. lactis
ip_ultrabiotic_dms.src: Strains, CFU and directions: products DB R829 (Pure Encapsulations and Metagenics switch charts, catalog ND143 10/1/26): 'NutriDyn 30 billion (7 strains: S. boulardii, L. reuteri, B. lactis, L. plantarum, L. acidophilus, L. gasseri, B. coagulans)', 30 billion CFU at time of manufacture; 'Take one capsule daily or as directed by your healthcare practitioner.'; Standard Process chart: S. boulardii 5 billion CFU. A web search on 2026-11-03 shows the nutridyn.com/ultrabiotic-daily-multi-strain listing (indexed) and NutriDyn sell sheet ND460 with the same seven strains (S. boulardii Lynside, L. reuteri LRC, B. lactis UABla-12, L. plantarum UALp-05, L. acidophilus UALa-01, L. gasseri UALg-05, Bacillus coagulans UABc-20), 'dairy-free, vegetarian' and the caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use' (page not opened, nutridyn.com blocked). The serving line names S. boulardii (with its own 5 billion, so the number cannot be read as 5 billion of each) and the two strains ND584 asks for (L. acidophilus and B. lactis, i.e. Bifidobacterium lactis; Bacillus coagulans is not named on the line, so the one 'B.' cannot be read two ways); the full seven are S. boulardii, L. reuteri, L. acidophilus, L. plantarum, L. gasseri, Bifidobacterium lactis and Bacillus coagulans. Six of the seven are bacteria and S. boulardii is a yeast, hence the header 'Add friendly microbes'. Sizes R829 30C, R829L 60C. Protocol: Asher's GI-MAP protocol email, 2025-01-30 (high zonulin or calprotectin) lists Akkermansia Plus, Complete or Daily Multi-Strain; the NutriDyn GLC 2023 5R protocol list (CSO) names UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain under Prebiotic/Probiotic; ND584 Rev. 1/22 REINOCULATE, 'This stage occurs during days 1-10', asks for 'a probiotic supplement containing both L. acidophilus and B. lactis', which this formula has (ND584's own example is UltraBiotic Complete, whose only reachable photo is a 160 px thumbnail). The label dose is printed (the GI-MAP email's 2 a day is above the label), for the protocol's days 1 to 10. Bedtime: the NutriDyn 60-day protocol conversion doc ('UltraBiotic Daily Multi-Strain 1 cap At bedtime'), which also keeps it away from the Remove-step herbs on the Gut Overgrowth sheet. Photo: build/img-src/R829.png, 736x1356 text-safe upscale of the 420 px web render.

ip_gi_restore.name: GI Restore
ip_gi_restore.key: 12 g protein, 2.5 g L‑glutamine, prebiotics (2.5 g arabinogalactan, 2 g 2'-FL), 200 mg NAC (N‑acetylcysteine), 18.75 mg zinc
ip_gi_restore.src: Amounts and directions: products DB R326C (catalog ND143 10/1/26 p.101 as read by the Metagenics and Biotics Research switch charts; the catalog prints one panel, Vanilla R326V, 35.78 g scoop, 14 servings): protein 12 g, L-glutamine 2.5 g, 2'-fucosyllactose 2 g, larch arabinogalactans 2.5 g, zinc 18.75 mg, vitamin D3 10 mcg, folate 185.2 mcg DFE, N-acetyl-L-cysteine 200 mg; 'NutriDyn also lists arabinogalactans, 2'-FL, quercetin, aloe, slippery elm, NAC'; directions 'Shake canister before scooping. Mix 1 scoop in 8 ounces of water twice daily or as recommended by your healthcare practitioner.' A web search 2026-11-03 of NutriDyn's GI Restore sell sheet ND529 shows slippery elm bark 200 mg and the caution 'If you are pregnant, nursing, or taking medication, consult your healthcare practitioner before use' (sheet not opened, nutridyn.com blocked). Size line: flavors only, because the catalog prints 14 servings for the Vanilla panel only (Chocolate R326C, 541.1 g, not printed). Both arabinogalactan (a larch fiber) and 2'-FL (2'-fucosyllactose, a milk sugar made for supplements) are prebiotics, so the serving line groups them under that word; NAC is spelled out. Quercetin, aloe and slippery elm are listed without amounts, so they are left off the serving line. Protocol: ND584 Rev. 1/22 RESTORE & RETAIN step 'Dynamic GI Restore: 1 scoop twice daily, from day 11 to day 24 (2 canisters)', same as the label. Claims: NutriDyn CSO pearls video chapters (repo onboard pearls page) 'GI Restore: gut barrier, mucin layer, and prebiotic support'; Asher's email, 2019-07-31: 'Gi Restore is for patients with Leaky Gut or other Inflammatory Bowel Syndromes' (a sales note; the sheet prints structure/function wording only). URL: web search 2026-11-03 indexes the /dynamic-gi-restore slug (not opened, nutridyn.com blocked). Daily rhythm: its two scoops REPLACE the GI Integrity + GI Defend shakes on days 11 to 24 (the plan line under the rhythm says so), so they are listed as 'serving (1 scoop) from day 11' (one serving is one scoop, per the label: one unit with the column's '1 scoop twice daily') and left out of the kit's scoop count, which therefore reads the true daily peak (days 1 to 10: 4 scoops). PHOTO MISSING: no GI Restore image exists in the repo, the scratchpad, the product DB, the practice kit or any switch chart; the masters are R326V_Web and R326C_Web (420 px) in Dropbox /NutriDyn/Product Images/Product Images (1)/, and the Dropbox content host is blocked from this session. Stage one as build/img-src/R326V.png (with the same text-safe upscale R325 and R829 got) and this entry picks it up. Never put a different bottle in this slot.
